title: Record a host's real hook payloads, not from documentation
body: To learn what a harness really sends a hook, turn on "Record hook payloads" in the review UI's Settings (this machine; .dd/local/settings.json record_payloads: true), trigger the tool call, read .dd/local/payloads.jsonl, then turn it off. In a project that has not opted in, set DD_CAPTURE_PAYLOADS=<file> in the environment the hooks run with instead: src/engine/machine.cjs appends every command and payload, as the harness sent it, as one JSON line. Do not trust a documentation summary for a payload's shape, and do not register new events from the agent in .claude/settings.local.json: auto mode refuses that edit as self-modification, so an event not yet registered needs the user or a --plugin-dir session.
not_derivable: On 2026-09-24 a capture contradicted a docs-derived summary of Claude Code's payloads, and adding PostToolUseFailure to settings.local.json was denied by the permission classifier; neither shows in the code.

evidence.summary: recordPayload: the setting and the environment variable.
